Package com.smu.mtc

Class MLDSA

java.lang.Object
com.smu.mtc.MLDSA
public class MLDSA extends Object
Main class for handling Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) operations. Provides functionalities for ML-DSA and ML-KEM key generation, X.509 certificate issuance, and digital signature validation.

      public X509Certificate issueCertForUser(String userId, int certInd, String base64KemPublicKey, long create_time, long valid_time) throws Exception

      Throws:
      Exception - If public key decoding, building, or signing fails.
